note: Set A contains several substantive errors: it binds the quartz thickness 1-3/16" to PT1 (a 4"x12" tile), invents a WB material of 'ACCENT PAINT PRATT & LAMBERT STEEL WOOL 33-14' when the wall base finish is 'AS NOTED ON ELEVATIONS', truncates the SK sink manufacturer to 'FR', and drops the leading 'B' from the bathroom-vanity faucet model. Set B is largely faithful across equipment, plumbing, furniture and millwork rows (e.g., BSP-L-65014LF-PC with tag F2, MWD02/MWD01/MWL01 dimensions, VANITY & SINK quantity 1), with only truncated manufacturer/description values ('TIERRA S', 'PORCELA') as defects.
